entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yo.
What's up?
You waiting to ambush me?
Who are you again?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ambush? C'mon, don't say shit like that.[n]Anyways...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man... I wasn't expectin' such a brutal[n]response. Anyways...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I wanna talk about that castle from[n]yesterday.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I tried tellin' myself it was all just a[n]dream... but I couldn't do it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I can't act like nothing happened. It's all[n]connected to that bastard Kamoshida,[n]after all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I wanna find out what's up with that[n]place, no matter what.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And y'know, you're the only person I can[n]rely on for this stuff. So, you in?
Eh, it was just a dream.
I'm out.
Sure. What next?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You really think so? There's no way[n]we were both dreamin' the same exact[n]effed up castle.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You've gotta be wonderin' what the[n]deal was too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't be like that. You've gotta be[n]wonderin' what the deal with that[n]place was too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nice! Okay, glad we're in this together.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think we should just try and retrace our[n]steps from yesterday.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: In the meantime, you're walkin' to the[n]station, right? Let's go together.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Lemme know if you notice any other[n]weird buildings on the way.
Ryuji doesn't seem like a bad guy.
I should probably just go along[n]with this...
